name: RadialContactFan
job: One round button that fans out into contact actions (call, directions, message, book) along an arc with labels
visitor_action: click/tap to open; arrows or Tab cycle actions; Esc closes
mobile: fans upward from bottom corner of its container, large targets
motion: actions spring out along the arc with stagger, main icon rotates to a close mark (reduced-motion: actions appear instantly in a row)
provenance: original, built from a concept description
art_direction: Concierge desk: warm ivory surface, deep navy main disc, brass-edged action discs, subtle satin gloss and soft cast shadows
notes: Not yet seen in a browser (shot.sh deferred to QA). Max 5 actions (extra ones are dropped so labels stay readable on a phone); label widths and the heading/bloom clearance at 760-900px container widths are the first things to check.
